Hero.title: [AR] Lasting weight loss, with a surgeon and a team who stay with you.
Hero.lead: [AR] Led by Dr. Mohsen Karam, FRCS (UK), Delta Bariatric Center brings surgery, nutrition, psychology and physiotherapy together under one roof — so every step of your journey is planned, not improvised.
Hero.leadShort: [AR] Led by Dr. Mohsen Karam, FRCS (UK) — surgery, nutrition, psychology and physiotherapy under one roof.

Procedures.title: [AR] The right procedure for your body — not a one-size plan.
Procedures.titleShort: [AR] The right procedure for your body.
Procedures.aside: [AR] Every patient starts with a full assessment. Together, we choose the option that fits your health, your goals and your life.

sleeve.name: [AR] Sleeve gastrectomy
sleeve.desc: [AR] Removes the larger part of the stomach, reducing how much you can eat and the hunger hormone it produces.
sleeve.descShort: [AR] Removes the larger part of the stomach to reduce appetite and intake.
sleeve.meta: [AR] Stay [X days] · Back to work [X weeks]

bypass.name: [AR] Gastric bypass
bypass.desc: [AR] Full or partial (mini) bypass: a small stomach pouch is connected directly to the small intestine.
bypass.descShort: [AR] Full or partial bypass — a small pouch joined to the small intestine.
bypass.meta: [AR] Stay [X days] · Back to work [X weeks]

plication.name: [AR] Gastric plication
plication.desc: [AR] The stomach is folded inward and stitched to reduce its volume — no part of the stomach is removed.
plication.descShort: [AR] The stomach is folded and stitched — nothing is removed.
plication.meta: [AR] Stay [X days] · Back to work [X weeks]

balloon.name: [AR] Gastric balloon
balloon.desc: [AR] A soft balloon placed by endoscopy for a set period — a first step for patients who need moderate weight loss.
balloon.descShort: [AR] Placed by endoscopy for a set period, no surgery.

Procedures.notSure: [AR] Not sure which one fits you? That is exactly what the first consultation is for.

Departments.title: [AR] Seven departments. One plan, built around you.
Departments.lead: [AR] Surgery is one day. Success is the year that follows. Your surgeon, dietitian, psychologist and physiotherapist work from the same file, in the same building — and see you at every stage.

bariatricSurgery.name: [AR] Bariatric surgery
bariatricSurgery.desc: [AR] Assessment, surgery and surgical follow-up with Dr. Karam.

bariatricMedicine.name: [AR] Bariatric medicine
bariatricMedicine.desc: [AR] Medical preparation before surgery and monitoring after it.

clinicalNutrition.name: [AR] Clinical nutrition
clinicalNutrition.desc: [AR] Staged eating plans, from the first liquids to lifelong habits.

psychology.name: [AR] Psychology
psychology.desc: [AR] Preparing for change and building a healthier relationship with food.

physiotherapy.name: [AR] Physiotherapy
physiotherapy.desc: [AR] Safe movement and strength programs adapted to each stage.

plasticSurgery.name: [AR] Plastic surgery
plasticSurgery.desc: [AR] Body contouring once your weight has stabilized.

dermatology.name: [AR] Dermatology
dermatology.desc: [AR] Skin care during and after major weight loss.
